name: Acne and acne-treatment skincare routines
what_it_is: Videos center on acne and the products and routines people use to treat it: tretinoin and prescription creams, pimple patches, pharmacy remedies, isotretinoin/Accutane, zinc oxide barrier creams, daily face washing, and extraction clips. Each is a separate creator's own skincare experience, with no single shared triggering moment.
